newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgarian election set for April 19.
newsitem.headline: Bulgarian election set for April 19.

text.p: Bulgarian President Petar Stoyanov said on Wednesday he was dissolving parliament from February 19 and general elections would be held on April 19.
"Today I issued a decree dissolving parliament with effect from February 19 and setting elections for April 19," Stoyanov said at a swearing-in ceremony for the caretaker cabinet.
After 30 days of mass protests, the Socialists last week gave up efforts to form a new government and agreed to elections in April, 20 months before the end of their parliamentary term.
The caretaker cabinet is headed by Sofia mayor Stefan Sofianski.
Bulgaria's ambassador to Bonn, Stoyan Stalev, will be foreign minister, and the deputy finance minister from the outgoing Socialist government, Svetoslav Gavriiski, will be finance minister.
